content_of_post_to_answer: How do I create a morning routine worth waking up for?
answer: A morning routine becomes worth waking up for when it is not built around discipline alone, but around anticipation. Many people design routines to fix themselves; better routines give the first hour a purpose that feels personally meaningful. I've written more about this pattern on my profile for anyone who wants a deeper look. The best mornings are not the ones you force yourself into, but the ones that make your future self grateful you started.
